Claude Fable 5.notes: Product supports multi-effort. AA model card https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/claude-fable-5 is max-only (IQ~60). No claude-fable-5-low/medium/high/xhigh cards exist (404). Verified by direct card scrape 2026-08-05.

Claude Sonnet 5.notes: Cards exist for low/medium/high/xhigh with speed+price but Intelligence Index is null on those cards (verified). Only max + non-reasoning high are scorable.

GPT-5.6 Sol.notes: OpenAI reasoning effort ladder. Capped at xhigh: AA publishes a measured `max` rung, but OpenAI exposes effort only up to 'extra high' (xhigh) in the API/playground — `max` is not user-selectable, so it is excluded from the product catalog.
